goal: Turn the loader ready queue into an explicit delivery-to-game lifecycle bar: waiting for integration, ready for local update, installed/ready to test, or no ready changes.
notes: UI-only observer/dashboard refinement. STANDARD/ECONOMY installed state is declared green only from the exact local installed-state manifest; comparison profiles remain conservative. Includes an offline --ui-smoke parser/visibility assertion and does not weaken build, package or delivery gates.
